span.p:
0 · Prepare the platform
environments, licences, service account, standards

div.style: color: rgb(13, 44, 84) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 420px; text-align: center;

span.p:
1 · Discover
list every workflow, form and dependency

div.style: color: rgb(13, 44, 84) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 420px; text-align: center;

span.p:
2 · Triage and plan
retire, replace, rebuild or redesign; plan the waves

div.style: color: rgb(31, 15, 77) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 420px; text-align: center;

span.p:
3 · Export and analyse
decode the export, write the analysis

div.style: color: rgb(31, 15, 77) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 420px; text-align: center;

span.p:
4 · Design
map every action, write the rebuild guide and tests

div.style: color: rgb(31, 15, 77) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 420px; text-align: center;

span.p:
5 · Build
child flows first, then the main flow, in Development

div.style: color: rgb(31, 15, 77) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 420px; text-align: center;

span.p:
6 · Prove parity
run the same tests in Nintex and Power Automate

div.style: color: rgb(31, 15, 77) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 420px; text-align: center;

span.p:
7 · Go live
deploy, switch new starts, let old runs finish

div.style: color: rgb(18, 61, 21) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 420px; text-align: center;

span.p:
8 · Operate and improve
monitor, fix known defects, retire the Nintex workflow
